name: Giridhar
tagline: I build tools that fix real problems.

reddit-native-mcp.tagline: Whole Reddit threads for AI agents. No API keys.
reddit-native-mcp.what: MCP server that gives AI agents whole Reddit threads, including every collapsed reply. No API key needed.
reddit-native-mcp.result: Fetches a full 191-comment thread in **2.2 s**; cached repeats in **40 ms**

secure-klipper.tagline: Encrypted clipboard history for KDE Plasma.
secure-klipper.what: Fork of KDE Plasma's clipboard manager. Only the newest entries stay readable; older ones are encrypted on disk with Argon2id and a password.
secure-klipper.result: Works on Plasma 6.7; covered by tests

thermal-guard.tagline: Stops old Intel laptops freezing from heat.
thermal-guard.what: Software thermal throttle for old Intel laptops that overheat until they freeze. Lowers the i915 GPU clock step by step as temperature rises.
thermal-guard.result: Under a GPU stress test, the laptop froze at **104 °C** with no guard. With thermal-guard it ran the full 80 s, mostly **below 92 °C**

yt-curated-feed.title: YT Curated Feed
yt-curated-feed.tagline: YouTube with only the channels you chose.
yt-curated-feed.what: Replaces the YouTube homepage with only the channels you chose. Hides Shorts, autoplay and recommendations.
yt-curated-feed.result: Zero dependencies, no servers, no tracking

statsify.title: Statsify
statsify.what: Private Spotify listening stats, with an optional desktop companion app.
statsify.result: All data stays on the device

windows-virtual-monitor-loopback.tagline: View a virtual monitor locally, GPU to GPU.
windows-virtual-monitor-loopback.metric: No VM, no network, no encoder
windows-virtual-monitor-loopback.what: Shows a virtual monitor in a window on the same PC, with input forwarding. Uses Windows Graphics Capture and keeps frames on the GPU.
windows-virtual-monitor-loopback.result: No VM, network or video encoder involved

firefox-extension-sideload.title: Persistent XPI Toolkit
firefox-extension-sideload.tagline: Keep unsigned extensions installed in release Firefox.
firefox-extension-sideload.what: Source patch and verifier that keep unsigned WebExtensions installed in normal Firefox release builds.

claude-continue.tagline: Resumes a Claude chat the moment its limit resets.
